voice_direction.direction: Quick and buoyant while fixing; slow naturally at the honest admission. Do not force a sad voice.
Dry warmth, never eye-rolling contempt. 'Our way' is an invitation.
Calm and direct. 'What happened?' contains concern, not accusation.
Crisp exact numbers and delighted underplaying; banner lines sound comfortable, not trapped.

foley: rubbery berry pocks in three pitches
scene_audio.music_intent: Light plucked-wood motif starts after the first ricochet and lands on the basket catch; curious, not magical.
scene_audio.silence_or_space: Leave a half beat after the perfect catch before Yeti speaks.

foley: bare feet and paws shifting on cart wood
scene_audio.music_intent: Playful walking rhythm loses one beat when the brake drops, then holds a sustained comic tone during the silent stare.
scene_audio.silence_or_space: Drop all but wheels and wind for the alarmed two-shot and Yeti's quiet line.

ambience: gathering green chatter safely moving aside
scene_audio.music_intent: Six-note rhythmic layer makes the repeating bounce pattern audible without becoming frantic.
scene_audio.silence_or_space: Clear June's pattern line by thinning bounce pitches beneath it.

scene_audio.music_intent: Comedy peaks with the synchronized return, then music recedes completely when Yeti sees his friends.
scene_audio.silence_or_space: Protect two breaths before Yeti says 'No.' Keep only one soft awning flap and distant market air.

scene_audio.music_intent: Build the opening motif by adding one character-sized layer per contribution; resolve only when all six berries land.
scene_audio.silence_or_space: Thin the score under Yeti's two waits so timing comes from the bounce sounds.

scene_audio.music_intent: Warm, minimal reprise. Stop on Tumble's question; finish with one light pluck on Yeti's grin.
scene_audio.silence_or_space: Hold the synchronized eyebrow reaction without added comedy effects.

mix_principles: Dialogue remains intelligible without flattening the forest and market ambience.
Each of the six berries gets a stable, gentle bounce pitch so the solution is audible and visual.
Runaway sounds stay wooden, soft, and playful; never use harsh crash or injury effects.
Music steps away from the emotional turn and never announces the lesson.
copyright_note: All music directions describe original emotional and instrumental intent; no existing song or artist imitation is requested.
